source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 1259 changes Folder Pane Header from F to P because Favorite Folders already uses F in View/Folders. Current English Fluent retains P/F, and both items appear in the same menu popup. A scoped localization recommendation is to check sibling access keys and their consuming menu rather than only the changed string. This does not assign P universally or prove collision-free translations in other locales. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: Choose access keys among sibling actions in the same menu
